author: ahmetsjw
quote: I don't understand how it got a 99—it seems really childish. They went out of their way to make it a family game, and this unfortunate game is the result.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: ahmetsjw
quote: I didn't really like this game aimed at 7-year-olds. The graphics look like they're from the AI era—they haven't improved even though 30 years have passed.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: ahmetsjw
quote: The best game of all time. Every minute is fun—it’s never boring. The negative reviews are just ragebait. Stay calm and enjoy playing the best game of all time.
